No exceptions, Oliver! … Maya: Diego does the dishes — there are only six plates today. … Maya: Ingrid and I do the shopping at the market. … Maya: Oliver makes lunch. Please, not pizza again… okay, pizza again. … Maya: And Kili? Kili makes everyone laugh. That's his official chore! … Ingrid: When we finish, we all make a big lemonade and rest on the balcony.
